### What is Starter Suite? 

Starter Suite is a turnkey CRM from Salesforce that brings sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack together on one connected platform, built for small teams that want to get started quickly. Every team works from the same view of the customer, so sales, service, and marketing stay in sync. Starter Suite also includes Agentforce Coworker, an AI teammate that answers questions from your Salesforce data, updates records after you confirm, and sends personalized emails through simple chat, with no upgrade required. Setup is guided, so teams can get started quickly. When your needs grow, you can upgrade to Pro Suite for advanced customization and automation.

...

### How do I get started with Starter? 

Getting started is completely turnkey. Simply sign up for a free 30-day trial to begin exploring the platform immediately. To help you hit the ground running, take advantage of these built-in resources: - Guided Checklist: Follow step-by-step guidance to set up your CRM in minutes. - Interactive Demos: Click through and see Starter Suite's tools in action before you build. - Live Workshops: Learn best practices directly from our experts in guided, interactive sessions. When you're ready, you can easily purchase Starter Suite through our simple self-checkout.

...

### How much does Starter cost? 

Starter is available starting at $25 USD per user, per month, which can be billed monthly or annually. Check out this data sheet to learn more about the features included in Starter. Starter includes 2,000 emails per month. Plus, you can add on more as needed with the Marketing Email Sends Bundle for an additional 1,000 email sends for $10 USD per month. Commerce functionality in Starter are subject to transaction fees. Pricing is pay-as-you-go and rates vary by region and payment method. For example, credit card payments in the U.S. are 2.9% + $0.30 USD per transaction.

### What are the main pricing plans for Sales Cloud? 

Sales Cloud offers flexible pricing plans to grow with your business. Choose from Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Core, Advanced, and Max — each with increasing levels of AI, automation, integration, and customization. Want help finding the right fit? Request a call with a Salesforce account executive to learn more.

### How does Sales Cloud pricing work? 

Sales Cloud pricing follows a per-user, per-month subscription model. You pay a monthly fee for each user who needs access. Pricing varies by edition, with each offering different features and levels of functionality to fit your business needs.

### Is there a free version of Sales Cloud? 

Salesforce offers a free 30-day trial for all Sales Cloud editions, with simple setup so you can get started quickly and explore key sales capabilities. If you'd like to explore an all-in-one CRM experience across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack, you can also start a free 30-day trial of Starter Suite for up to 10 users.

### How much does Starter Suite cost? 

Starter Suite costs $25 USD per user, per month. It's an all-in-one CRM designed for small businesses, bringing together sales, service, marketing and commerce tools. Plus, it includes Slack at no extra cost for seamless collaboration.

### Can I pay monthly? 

You can purchase licenses of Salesforce Starter with a monthly or annual contract. To get started, sign up and purchase Salesforce Starter directly from a free trial. All other subscriptions are generally paid annually in advance.

...

### How does the free trial work? 

Simply fill out the free trial form, and your free trial will open inside the same window. From there, you can import data in minutes and take a look at everything we can do for your business. Trial subscriptions cannot be used in a production capacity and must be used only for non-production purposes.

Whenever you’re ready to buy, hit “Buy Now” from within your trial to purchase licenses. When your trial expires, you will be prompted to buy or give us a call for more info.
